groups.note: Municipal, school, special-district, and county names for terms beginning January 2027 are keyed from the official Uinta clerk 2026 general summary (DocumentCenter slug still says Unofficial; the official Elections page and the PDF header label Official Results, dated 11/05/2026 12:58PM). Official 2022 and 2024 Uinta clerk general summaries were not posted on the current official elections page (https://uintacountywy.gov/26/Elections), and official SOS Uinta precinct-by-precinct summaries omit county, municipal, and school offices, so earlier January local rows are Not yet collected rather than invented. Evanston and Lyman mayors appear on the official 2026 November ballot and are not council-selected. Mountain View and Bear River mayors were not on the official 2026 general. Official mid-term vacancies are not invented.

groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are 3rd Judicial District judges (Lincoln, Sweetwater, and Uinta). Full names are taken from official SOS lines or official Wyoming Judicial Branch 3rd JD pages, and those sources are cited. Judges of other districts are not copied here.
